description_en: Queries the available near-origin traffic diversion quota
description_zh: 查询可用的近源流量压制次数
name: DescribeUnBlockCount

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

RemainCount.description_en: The remaining number of available near-origin traffic diversion sessions
RemainCount.description_zh: 剩余可用的近源流量压制次数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of available near-origin traffic diversion sessions
TotalCount.description_zh: 总共可用的近源流量压制次数
